reasoning: Shows a triangular martini/cocktail glass crossed out by a diagonal slash, representing no alcohol, sobriety, Dry January, or mocktails. Useful for health challenges and event planning, though the geometric triangular bowl with a vertical stem and horizontal liquid line can easily be misread at small sizes as a crossed-out filter funnel or an abstract geometric glyph.
